name: com.mdj.dynamicnpcs
description: Fully local, voiced NPC dialogue for Unity. An embedded llama-server writes each reply in character and embedded NeuTTS speaks it with a cloned per-NPC voice, streamed sentence-by-sentence so the NPC starts talking before the reply finishes generating. No cloud services, no Python at runtime, nothing for players to install.

samples.description: A minimal scene script with an on-screen chat box wired to an NpcDialogueAgent.
